source_collation.figure_table: All sixteen four-row identities visually compared with Princeton hcafig1; no selected pattern difference observed.
source_collation.procedure: Original pp5–7 agree with selected transcription construction and parity; rendering does not reverse logical order.
text_differences: Princeton normalizes long-s and typography. The report uses the editorial English label Judge; this release does not claim diplomatic transcription of the historical typography.
Original p8 really repeats first House for fourth Daughter in alternate projection. No silent correction; alternate projection excluded.
source_collation.historical_diagrams: Original p6–7 diagrams inspected as collation context; dash/star alignment is not adopted as an independently certified complete chart fixture. Bennett published dot-chart is the 15-position reference; further original diagram collation remains P1.
source_collation.excluded: Triplicities, signs, planets, house meanings and alternative astrological procedure not executable.

alias_policy: Exact canonical ID, Latin label or listed alias; case-insensitive casefold only, no trimming, fuzzy match or universal traditional renaming. Raw request retained. Patterns are four top-to-bottom 1/2 digits.
logical_order: M1..M4,D1..D4,N1..N4,W1,W2,Judge; positions 1..15. Display can reverse each tier only; it cannot change logical data or arithmetic.
binary: No external integer/bit representation. Internal figures and reports use displayed dot counts only.
unsupported: House projection including sequential and alternative astrological assignments
Horary judgment, yes/no certification, predictions, diagnoses and supernatural accuracy
Arabic-specific or generic universal geomancy profile
Planetary/elemental rulerships, triplicities, dignities, aspects, perfection and via puncti
Greer/Skinner procedure certification without inspected pages
source_limits: Complete sixteen-pattern and fifteen-position construction scope from selected Turner table/common procedure. Bennett worked diagram is an independent numerical comparison, not predictive validation.
